title: OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Astra bug fix causes faster usage limits
excerpt: OpenAI has announced that fixing a bug in GPT-6.2 Astra means users will reach their usage limits 40% faster than before.
body_html: OpenAI has confirmed the resolution of a software issue that previously provided an incorrect discount on GPT-6.2 usage. Because of this correction, individuals will now reach their designated usage caps approximately 40 percent faster than they did previously.
